MoRTH Spec. 1500, 1600 & 1700). Item is inclusive of cost of cement, coarse sand, coarse aggregate (20 mm & 10 mm), admixture (for M40 and above), labour (mate, mason, mazdoor), machinery/plant (batching plant @ 20 cum/hour, transit mixer 4 cum capacity, concrete pump; admixture @ 0.4% of cement weight), overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Rate analysis is carried out for an output of 120 cum. Formwork and staging cost has been added over the basic cost of labour, material & machinery as a percentage depending on the type of super-structure element (Cast-in-situ Box Girder, Segmental Construction & Balanced Cantilever (35-55% of cost of concrete for formwork)) and height of pier/support (Height above 10m).

data.name: Precast RCC Railing (M30 Grade)
data.rate_src: TNSOR 2025-26 Volume 1 and MORTH standard data book 2019
data.description: Construction of precast RCC railing of M30 grade, aggregate size not exceeding 12 mm, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings (MoRTH SD/202) and Technical Specifications (Ref. Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 5% additional formwork cost for casting-yard precasting, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, 5% cost addition for handling and fixing of precast panels, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%. Output taken as 48 m (2 x 24 m span). Fixed on top of the Deck Slab edge.

Clause 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700). Includes M30 grade concrete for 28 vertical posts and 3-tier hand rails (total 4.092 cum for 48 m run), 12% additional formwork cost, HYSD bar reinforcement @ 0.865 MT, overhead charges @ 20% and contractor's profit @ 10%.
